name: Range Slider
description: Neumorphic numbered range slider with an inset groove and a glossy glowing ball that glides to the selected step, built on a hidden native range input.
contents: Inset groove track with numbered step labels
Glossy round handle with accent glow
behavior: Handle slides with eased transition to the selected value
Native range input handles drag, click and keyboard
Handle position recalculated on window resize
